prompts.label: standing-white
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, an existing FluxRail full-body illustration. Refine this SAME illustration's silhouette and clothing/anatomy balance. Preserve exact girl identity, fluffy pale-blue bob, facial expression, eye style, white beret/pink star, waterdrop hair clip, manga linework, muted water-blue palette, sailor blouse and pleated skirt, shoes, the individual pose, framing and any controller. Make only a careful proportional correction: head including hair slightly smaller (about 5-8%, still cute); soft compact upper torso with a clearly readable natural waist; reduce the oversized balloon sleeves slightly and let cuffs end around the hip rather than midway down the skirt. Skirt attaches plausibly at the waist and falls naturally over hips; modest uniform skirt length, not exceptionally short, not a huge bell. Keep a cute petite full-body manga silhouette with balanced head, torso, hips and legs. Natural aligned legs, modest thigh volume tapering to calves, knee location midway between actual hip and ankle, comparable thigh/calf lengths; remove the collapsed inward knee posture and strongly bowed shins. Feet rest naturally, ankles connect cleanly to moderate-size closed-toe shoes. Do not just lengthen legs or stretch the image. Both legs continuously covered under skirt to shoes by plain THICK OPAQUE MATTE WHITE tights, no bare skin, no translucent fabric, no glossy highlights, faint pale-blue contour shadow only. All three variants must have the SAME outfit proportions and white hosiery design. Flat gentle hand drawn illustration. Actual transparent background, isolated clean cutout, no glow, no gradient, no shadow, no scene, no text. Full hat and both shoes visible. Preserve the original character mood. Pose invariant: shy standing, hands softly close in front, gently smiling; subtly straighten the legs while keeping relaxed stance.
